1: # Tasks: Implement Phase 1 Trading UI
2: 
3: ## Overview
4: Incremental implementation of Phase 1 UI starting with foundation (theme, shared components) and building up to complete screens. Each task is independently verifiable and delivers user-visible progress.
5: 
6: ---
7:

12: - [ ] Import theme in `src/main.tsx`
13: - [ ] Verify all CSS variables load in browser dev tools
14: - [ ] Create `src/shared/styles/globals.css` for base resets and typography
15: 
16: **Validation:** Open app, inspect `:root` element, confirm all --var-* custom properties exist
17:

24: - [ ] Write component tests

94: ## Phase B: Vietnam Finance Services
95: 
96: ### Task B1: Implement commission calculation service
97: - [ ] Create `src/services/vietnam/commission.ts`
98: - [ ] Implement `calculateEntryCommission(entryValue)` (0.25%, min 500 VND)
99: - [ ] Implement `calculateExitCommission(exitValue)`
100: - [ ] Implement `calculateExitTax(exitValue)` (0.1%)
101: - [ ] Write comprehensive unit tests with edge cases
102: 
103: **Validation:** Run tests, verify calculations match spec examples exactly
104: 
105: ### Task B2: Implement net P&L calculation service
106: - [ ] Create `src/services/vietnam/pnl.ts`
107: - [ ] Implement `calculateNetPnL(grossPnL, entryComm, exitComm, exitTax)`
108: - [ ] Implement `calculateNetPnLPercent(netPnL, entryValue)`
109: - [ ] Implement `calculateRMultiple(currentPrice, entryPrice, stopPrice)`
110: - [ ] Write tests for winning and losing trades
111: 
112: **Validation:** Test with spec examples, verify net P&L = 3,971,464 for VCB example
113: 
114: ### Task B3: Implement position sizing service
115: - [ ] Create `src/services/vietnam/positionSize.ts`
116: - [ ] Implement `calculatePositionSize(capital, riskPercent, entry, stop)`
117: - [ ] Implement `adjustForLotSize(shares, lotSize)` (round down to nearest lot)
118: - [ ] Implement `calculatePositionValue(shares, price)`
119: - [ ] Write tests
120: 
121: **Validation:** Test: 100M capital, 1.5% risk, entry 85,600, stop 81,100 → 333 shares
122: 
123: ### Task B4: Implement T+2 settlement service
124: - [ ] Create `src/services/vietnam/settlement.ts`
125: - [ ] Implement `getSettlementDate(tradeDate)` accounting for weekends
126: - [ ] Create Vietnam holiday calendar (2025-2026)
127: - [ ] Implement `isHoliday(date)` and `isWeekend(date)`
128: - [ ] Write tests for weekday, weekend, holiday scenarios
129: 
130: **Validation:** Monday Jan 13 → settles Wednesday Jan 15, Friday Jan 10 → settles Tuesday Jan 14
